messages:
maya: ops-bot just fired a P1 paging on production inference error rate, I'm on it.
ops-bot: INCIDENT CREATED - ID: INC-2026-0427-77 · Severity: P1 · Trigger: /svc/inference/error_rate > 8% for 5m · Affected: hosted API (us-west-2) · Paging: eng-oncall · https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-0427-77
jonah: seeing a spike in 504s and decoding errors in the logs, might be model variant fallback thrashing. looking.
lisa: thanks — paging infra to check if any rollout happened in the last 30m.
oma: (bot) @lisa no recent deploys to hosted API in last 2h, last deploy 1767841200
ram: I'm pulling metrics to grafana now. preliminary: token latency steady, but request error rate jumped on small model pool.
maya: can someone check routing? maybe requests are routing to quantized variants with a mismatch.
kevin: on it. dumping router logs:```
2026-04-27T14:12:43Z ROUTER uid=svc-123 route=latency->variant-q8_1 reason=capacity-constrained
2026-04-27T14:12:44Z ROUTER uid=svc-123 route=latency->variant-q8_1 reason=capacity-constrained
2026-04-27T14:12:45Z SERVING uid=variant-q8_1 decode_error: token -1 invalid
```
jonah: that decode_error lines up with the 504s. variant-q8_1 is the new quantized variant we added for cost savings.
lisa: ops-bot, can we rollback routing to prefer baseline float16 variant for now?
ops-bot: ROUTE CHANGE REQUEST created by lisa · Action: set routing policy pref=fp16 for svc/inference · Pending approval from eng-oncall
maya: approving, go ahead.
ops-bot: ROUTE CHANGE APPLIED · routing pref=fp16 for svc/inference · timestamp=1767845250
ram: after change we see error rate dropping back to normal in the last 90s. saving graph.
jonah: quick follow-up: alert spam was intense — the P1 paging went to a lot of folks. we should discuss splitting noisy infra alerts vs customer-impacting pages.
maya: agree. this thread should capture mitigation and suggestions for postmortem + alert tuning.
kevin: immediate ask: change the alert so only errors with user-visible impact (4xx/5xx from API) page. internal decode_error alone should go to a ticket.
lisa: propose new policy: page when sustained 5xx rate > 1% AND total request volume > 500rps for 3m. otherwise fire an alert to #eng-ops but do not page.
jonah: +1. Also we need a separate alert for model-variant fallback churn — high rate of routing switches in 30s should be an internal signal (ticket) not customer page.
maya: add a dashboard card that combines routing churn, decode errors, and customer 5xx in a single view for triage. ram — can you create?
ram: working on a grafana panel: queries: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="redwood-api",status=~"5.."}[1m])) by (region)` and `sum(increase(router_switch_total[1m])) by (variant)`. will add annotations for route-change events.
kevin: we should also add suppression rules for alert storms during ongoing incident — like auto-silence duplicate pages for 15m for same alert fingerprint.
lisa: yes, and ensure runbook links are on the page: runbook -> /runbooks/inference-error-rate.md
maya: post-incident action items: 1) tune thresholds as lisa suggested 2) make decode_error non-paging unless customer 5xx present 3) add routing-churn ticketing alert 4) instrument metrics for variant compatibility checks 5) update on-call rotation doc with new page mappings.
oncall-bot: NOTE: handoff in 30m to next oncall (jonah). Suggested assignee for follow-ups: kevin (infra), ram (dashboards), lisa (alerts).
jonah: I'll take the handoff but kevin/ram/lisa should own their items. I'll file a short incident report and link this thread.
maya: thanks everyone — going to mark incident resolved once error rate is stable for 10m.
ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED - ID: INC-2026-0427-77 · Resolved at 1767846001 · Duration: 7m38s · Resolution: routing pref rollback to fp16; no customer data loss · https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-0427-77
ram: saved dashboard and created ticket TCK-881: "routing-churn-alert + dashboard" with subtasks for queries and runbook updates.
kevin: I updated the alert rule draft in ops-alerts repo:```
- name: prod_inference_customer_5xx
  expr: |
    sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="redwood-api",status=~"5.."}[3m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="redwood-api"}[3m])) > 0.01
  for: 3m
  severity: page
  conditions:
    min_request_volume: 500
  runbook: /runbooks/inference-error-rate.md
```
jonah: I'll review the PR and if green we'll roll to staging alerts tomorrow.
maya: green from me. one more: add a note to on-call doc about who to cc for routing rollbacks (kevin + infra).
lisa: I'll update the alerting matrix and send a summary in #eng-announcements after the postmortem is done. :white_check_mark:
maya: nice work team. closing thread after handoff.
jonah: ack, taking followups.
kevin: leaving a quick tip in the PR: avoid paging on low-volume spikes, use both relative and absolute thresholds.
ram: attaching dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd123/inference-triage
maya: thread closed.
